nom: Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Face and Skin; Facial Cleanser

avis.titre: Buffering issue. I think it works but may not be ideal for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I’ve purchased this spray a couple of time and have found it to be somewhat beneficial. Unlike some other reviews here, I actually weirdly like the slightly pool/chlorine smell. I have sprayed it just to get that blast of summer memories during the long winter months. It seems to calm down my acne and problematic skin, but I'm not sure how much. That being said, after doing more research, I realized I couldn’t find an official company website or clear brand information for “Aquia,” which made it difficult to verify how the product is formulated or tested. The ingredient list is very minimal (water + 0.015% hypochlorous acid), which suggests the formula may not be buffered. Btw, 0.015% HOCl = ~150 parts per million (ppm). That is within the typical skin-use range (100–200 ppm) Why does buffering matter? I did the deep dive so you don't have to, but please take note I'm just an ADHD mom on a mission and NOT a skin care professional. I guess hypochlorous acid tends to be most skin-friendly when its pH is kept stable. Without buffering, the chemistry can drift over time, which may increase the chlorine smell and be more irritating for people with sensitive or reactive skin (rosacea, eczema, etc). Ironically, the smell I enjoyed may actually be a sign of that instability. This doesn’t mean the product is unsafe (I don't think), but now that I understand more about buffering and formulation stability, I would personally like to try a different brand that is more transparent about t

I absolutely love this hypochlorous acid spray and use it every single day. The 8oz spray bottle is the perfect size to keep with me at home, in my bag, or in the car. I use it after work to quickly clean my hands when I’m on the go, and it’s also amazing for refreshing my face after the gym without drying out or irritating my skin. I also use it for my senior dog by spraying her paws after walks, and I’ve even used it on minor wounds, skin tags, and lumps to help keep the areas clean. It’s gentle enough for sensitive skin but still makes everything feel fresh and sanitized. Another reason I keep repurchasing it is how versatile it is. I use it to clean my razor after shaving and to sanitize my makeup brushes and tools regularly. The fine mist spray bottle works really well, and the product lasts longer than I expected. For the price, it’s an incredible value and one of those products that quickly becomes part of your daily routine.

avis.titre: works quickly, wish spray was fine mist
avis.texte: immediately noticed a difference within the first two days of using it! my redness isn’t as pigmented and I’ve been breaking out less (I have acne prone oily skin). only thing I don’t like about it is the spray nozzle, I wish it were more of a fine mist! Likely will transfer the liquid into another spray bottle.

avis.titre: Best value for price!!Best value for price!!
avis.texte: Hypochlorous acid is a very versatile product and thats why i love it so much! For acne prone skin specifically, its very effective for killing bacteria and soothing redness on a sensitive skin barrier. The concentration in this bottle is 0.015% which is different from other popular sprays utilizing 0.02%, however studies show 0.015% is JUST as effective at killing bacteria and is even less irritating than .02%. The product has a faint bleach/chlorine smell, which is standard and normal for any hypochlorous acid product. At this price point for 8oz, its unbeatable and definitely should be a staple product in anyones routine wether you have acne or not.

Been using this for a week as a “toner” after I use my cleanser and omg what a difference it’s made! It smells kind of like peroxide which doesn’t bother me at all, it’s very gentle on the skin. Before this I was struggling with cystic acne breakouts out of no where. As a 40 Year old woman I was embarrassed and felt like a teenager again. I’m so happy I found this and happy with the results! I have not had a breakout in over a week!

I LOVE this stuff! I’ve got my friends and sister hooked on it, too. I like to use it after working out if I’m not close to a shower, and when I wake up in the mornings. I have noticed less bumps on my forehead (which I tend to get from working out). The bottle works great, doesn’t leak, and it’s easy to use. It’s fragrance free which is a plus for my sensitive skin friends out there. This is on my permanent “must buy” list. Definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: Pure ingredients, FSA approved, and works really well!
avis.texte: I love this spray! I have an incision healing on my forehead, and I spritz my face with this a few times a day. It is antimicrobial, freshens your skin, has very mild odor, does not make skin oily or sticky, quickly absorbs, and is cost effective (and FSA approved!). It's a winner for me...

Works really well. Works stubborn acne heals better. I think it makes my skin feel softer but not more fragile. I will say that it does have a very salty almost like pool smell. But it doesn't last long and I find it somewhat refreshing. Will buy this product again. I am a very big fan.
Does not irritate my skin or eyes when applied. Very easy to use and has no smell.
Only gave 4 stars bc I just got it and started using. Also, new improved bottle?

avis.titre: Refreshing and Gentle for My SKin
avis.texte: I’ve been very pleased with this hypochlorous acid spray. It feels gentle on my skin, refreshes my face throughout the day, and leaves my skin feeling clean and calm. The spray is easy to apply and works well as part of my daily skincare routine. Great quality product, and I would purchase it again.
2 days of spraying and I have not itched. Not scratchin should give my skin time to heal. A true 8oz the same length as my large wallet
Been using this brand for a little while and like it but recently the sprayer changed and it uses a spring that rusts inside meaning you are spraying yourself with rust.

Glad I took a chance and purchased this face spray. Since I added this spray to my facial routine, my adult acne is healing and my face is starting to look brighter and more clear. Truly one if the best purchases I made.

avis.titre: Non sting, great after workouts or mid day fave refresh!
avis.texte: Love this! I use after everytime I wash my face. Soothing, non sting, helps decrease acne for me, and I use directly on eyelids to decrease bacteria on eyelids. I also spray my eyelash curler and let completely dry daily to decrease bacteria there too ( severe dry eye, and very sensitive eyes). Also use on face and armpits after workouts! Great to have in workout bag or travel bag. Actually works great for refresher makeup spray too!

I thought I really liked this brand but when I opened up the bottle to refill it, I saw the spray bottle spring area was all brown. I never have seen this with previous brands. I have been spraying this in my eye!! As I have down with mkt expensive brands.

I love this product. I use it after the gym, on a hot day, as a facial toner and to sanitized my makeup brushes. But it runs out so quickly. I would reccomend this item to anyone as it has many usages. I just wish they sold a bigger bottle or refills.
My skin does look fresher and it smells like a swimming pool so there is that. Ultimately, it is just overpriced hype.

avis.titre: Product received not as advertised, shoddy packaging
avis.texte: The hypochlorous solution in the bottle seems to be fine, my issue is with the packaging and what I received versus what is advertised here. The bottle I received was white, not blue, and the spring in the spray top started to rust and stain the tubing inside of the spray top. This was the second spray bottle I have purchased from this listing in the last six months, because the last one broke.
Disgusting brown build up in the spray bottle. I contacted the seller and got no response.

avis.titre: A good addition to anyone's skincare
avis.texte: This arrived in a padded bag with the spray top and cap missing. Not just fallen off in the bag, but altogether missing. The plastic seal was still present. This could be the shippers fault and not the product. I was able to find a spray top that fit and used this on my face. I have been making my own at home but wanted to try out one marketed specifically for skincare to see how it compares. It smells like pool water (standard) which is what it should smell like so I know it is active. This is supposed to kill bacteria and help sanitizer surfaces (I already use this for cleaning purposes) so it should keep cuts and scrapes clean and help with acne and other skin conditions. It's a nice and simple addition to anyone's skin care. I often like to spritz myself when I can't necessarily wash my face but feel like I'm not very clean (after pool or sweating)

This Hypochlorous Acid Spray is a great product!! It has many different uses, and it is very effective for the specific needs I was trying to address. I love that this comes in a convenient spray/mist bottle, so it makes applications very quick and easy. The coverage is great. This can be used for all over body acne, face acne, face moisturizing, piercing after care spray (to prevent infections and treat), blepharitis treatment for eyelids, chalazion eye treatment, eyelid & lash cleanser & more. This is SO versatile! I personally used it mostly for acne, and piercing care. I only get acne on occasion, but I'm having problems with my earring holes all the time. I'm very sensitive to most metals, and even if my ears come into contact with something, I get flare ups of oozing, bleeding ear piercing holes (16 years later!) . This product has been life changing, to manage and help heal those wounds. I highly recommend this product!

This review is for a 4oz bottle of Hypochlorous Spray. The bottle came shrink wrapped (yay!). I've been using a Hypochlorous spray in my skincare routine for awhile now. I thought I'd give this brand a try. The sprayer works well and dispenses a fine mist. Hypochlorous helps me with facial redness or irritation that I occasionally get. I either use it after washing my face and let air dry or at any point during the day I might just spray it on, wait a couple seconds and blot my face. I find it especially cooling on a hot day or when I have a hot flash. I just spritz a little bit on and sit in front of my electric fan. I have really long hair, on days that I don't wash it, I like to spray a little bit on my roots rub it in and let it air dry. I highly recommend Hypochlorous products.
I love love this face spray! It is so refreshing and make my skin breathe and my face feels so fresh and clean. Good to use after gym or even during the day as a refresher to skin.

avis.titre: Gentle, Multi-Use Spray for Skin, Eyes, and Aftercare
avis.texte: This hypochlorous acid spray is a surprisingly versatile product that can fit into many routines. It works well as a hydrating facial mist and gentle cleanser, leaving my skin feeling refreshed without any sticky residue. I especially appreciate its soothing effect on breakouts, it helps calm irritation on both face and body, including tricky spots like the back or chest. It’s also handy as a piercing aftercare spray. Compared to traditional saline, it feels gentler while still keeping the area clean. I’ve also used it around the eyes as a lid and lash cleanser, and it was non-irritating, helpful for managing dryness or mild eyelid discomfort. The travel-friendly bottle makes it easy to carry in a gym bag or purse, so I’ve been using it post-workout as a quick refresher. Overall, it’s a safe, multi-use spray that feels effective without being harsh.

I didn’t know Hypochlorous Acid was a thing but it has definitely made a difference in my face. I tend to have redness in my face and when I use this spray it helps to reduce that. It’s sprays out fine. I don’t think it’s too thin or too thick. It goes on like any other spray bottle. I use it in the morning after cleansing my and toning my face. I let it sit on my skin and air dry. Once dry I can continue with my routine. It smells like nothing but water. The acid levels is under .02 percent so it’s not strong. If you are looking for a good Hypcholorous Acid this is a real contender.

I am obsessed with hypochlorus acid, and have been using it almost daily both for facial skincare and to help with minor scrapes and cuts. I’ve tried several brands, and was happy to try this Aquia brand spray. While it does have that signature pool chlorine smell, this one has an added smell of plastic, kind of like a pool float left out in the sun? I don’t know if it’s the formula itself or the packaging, but it makes me a little weary of the formula. Mine came in a more utilitarian package design. I do like that it’s made in the USA, but I’m not sure if I would repurchase this due to the slightly suss smell.

avis.titre: A gentle solution and good for so many things
avis.texte: Aquia Hypochlorous Acid Spray review I like this spray and think it is an excellent product. It is a gentle solution and causes no issues when I use it. When I spray this it smells like hypochlorous acid should smell with the faint smell of chlorine like in a swimming pool. The bottle I was sent is white unlike the blue shown in the listing photos. The bottle was shrink wrapped and I appreciated knowing that it had been sealed and no one else had been able to mess with it. I like that the sprayer sprays a fine mist every time. I am very pleased with this spray.

Since the spray is unscented and hypochlorous acid has a slight bleach smell to it, so the spray has a slight bleach smell. This isn't a major problem to me, but I know many of the sprays on the market now have some sort of scent or neutralizer in them to keep the smell out. The higher concentration also magnifies the smell. It dissipates pretty quickly after it's sprayed and dries in my experience, but I'm not using it on my face. I use this as a sanitizer of sorts for my skin. If I get a small nick or cut I will give it a spritz, if I have any sort of scratch I will give it a spritz, anything that needs a bandage gets a spritz before the bandage goes on. This is one of my favorite things to use as a skin sanitizer because it doesn't have any sort of stinging but still has anti-microbial effects. This spray is currently priced at $9.99. I've gotten much smaller containers at higher prices. I feel that this is an amazing value, honestly. Many skincare grade hypochlorous acid solutions are much more expensive.

One of the things that sets this hypochlorous mist apart from others is the fact that it actually lists the solution strength. It shows me it's transparent about its formulation, so I know exactly what I'm spraying on my skin. From what I've learned, between 0.01% and 0.02% is ideal for skin, and at 0.015% it's just right for mine, which is very acne prone. I'd say this dilution is a good middle ground to start with. It's strong, but not overly harsh. It does a great job at preventing breakouts for me, and when they do happen I notice they clear up much more quickly. The spray from the spray bottle is somewhat narrower than I'm used to, so I have to spray at a bit of a distance from my face, and the mist isn't as fine as I'd like it to be, but it's similar to many other face mists I've used, and is perfectly fine. You also get a lot of solution comparatively, making it a really good value. Definitely give it a shot.

I consistently use these types of sprays after a good day out of the house, as I like to dress up in alternative ways and take good care of my clothes. When I come home, I spray this onto clothes which helps them out before they eventually have to go through the washer. Helps deodorize, disinfect, all the good stuff!! The concentration is even lower than another brand I tried... This is 0.015%, while the other is 0.02% which will have its uses I suppose, but I prefer the increased effectiveness of the higher concentration. Since it's lower concentration, it means there's even more just... regular water content in this than others. It means I have to use a LOT more in order to get the same result. So the price is honestly a bit deceptive. I still appreciate that it's transparent about this and it does work though, so props to that.

I recently discovered hypochlorous acid and now I use it every day with a great result. I have a couple of spots on my face that are prone to breakouts. After I wash my face morning and night, I spray a little of this on my problem areas. I allow it to air dry for a few minutes before I apply my moisturizer. It provides some additional cleansing which for me is the boost I need to keep the breakouts at bay. On warmer summer days I sometimes use a little spritz on other areas of my skin that are prone to breakouts, like my back. For an 8 ounce bottle this is a great value and will last a long time. I also like that this is made in the USA.

I bought this item because sometimes I get flare ups on my skin due to allergies. It is easier to spray than rub something on the flare ups, so this is perfect. I experience immediate relief when it is applied and takes an hour for it to work. I also apply it on itchy dry skin and surprisingly it alleviates the flare up too and doesn't make it worse. Good and clean product. Smells a little initially but at least there is no weird fragrance added in making it natural. I keep it on my work desk for easy access.

I've never tried hypochlorous acid spray before but from what I've read about it, it seems like a worthwhile item to add to my daily use. The bottle arrived nicely sealed with plastic around the full bottle. There's a strip of plastic that's perforated to easily remove the seal. The ingredients listed is also very simple. It's just the hypochlorous and water. The spray bottle provided a nice thin mist after the first couple of pumps to get it ready. Afterwards the bottle remained ready to go with a nice mist. I used the spray on my face and there was no noticeable scent. I'd say it means towards unscented as there were no noticable fragrances. My skin did not experience any reactions at all. Overall my experience was very positive. Looking around, this also seems to be a great price for the size making the value really good as well. As my experience is still short, for now, I would recommend this.

avis.titre: Good spray for many issues, including odor
avis.texte: I ordered this spray for one of my adult kids who, no matter how much deodorant they use or how often they wash, has some issues with body odor. A dermatologist suggested that they try hypochlorous acid spray, as it has a good track record of neutralizing not only acne, but also body odor. I ordered this particular bottle because it was a nice sized bottle, giving it good value for the money. The bottle works well; the spray comes out nicely, and it doesn't leak. The spray is effective, as it is definitely helping the odor issue, without causing any skin irritation. I'm very happy with this order.

I was using a different brand that is more expensive and thought maybe I could try a more affordable spray. It smells like chlorine bad and broke my forehead out. I learned that HOCI will smell that way when it’s not stabilized, free chlorine. Glad it works for some but I will return and just stick to the one I’m used to with no smell or breakouts.

This came in packaging that looks completely different than the photos. When choosing between other options in the same quantity and price range I chose this one because I liked the packaging the best. I didn’t want to be wasteful and return, plus I frankly needed the product immediately and am not one to use and return especially when it’s about packaging. The spray nozzle is really good though
I haven’t used it because there are 2 bugs in the cap the protects the spray nozzle
There was blood or poop on the back of the cap. Unhygienic. Gross. Threw it away.

I had seen many ads recently for products like this, so I was very excited to have the opportunity to try this product! I've read some people say it smells like a pool. When you spray it in your skin, you really don't smell a whole lot of anything. If you unscrew the top and smell in the bottle, you definitely get a faint pool water smell. I'm very scent sensitive and this didn't bother me in the slightest. So, please note that I'm just sharing my experience and I don't make any medical claims or promises. I have a patch of skin on my leg that is always itchy and sometimes bleeds from my scratching it too much. I started using this and it really seems to help. I feel like I'm scratching much less and I haven't had any bleeding, either. I've been impressed with this so far and I'm looking forward to seeing how it does on other areas of my body. This is a really good value, too. I recommend this product for sure!

avis.titre: Refreshing, new type of product for me
avis.texte: I've never used a product like this before, but I really am satisfied with it. First, it feels refreshing and amazing when I spritz my face with it. Second, it is a safe way to cleanse my sensitive skin. I especially enjoy it after working out and the bottle can go in my bag with its anti-spill pump. For just about $9.50 you receive a plastic spray bottle with 4 ounces, which seems to be an excellent price for this type of product. Made in the USA. My bottle is white, not blue like in the picture. It also didn't come in a box, but is safety wrapped with cellophane.

My teenage son has been dealing with skin that is breaking out, especially since he is active every day in sports and working out. I had been reading about the benefits of using Hypochlorous Acid Spray and thought I would have him give it a try. This Aquia Hypochlorous Acid Spray has been working well for him after about a week of use. The bottle comes safety sealed upon delivery. It is a spray bottle, which makes application a breeze. My son has been using it one to two times daily for about a week now. He will cleanse his face with his regular cleanser and pat dry. After he has dried his face he will apply a light spray on his face and allow it to sit until it dries. So far, he has noticed that his face has less irritation and break outs than it had before. The spray has not caused any irritation to his skin. It’s fragrance-free as well. He is careful with how often he uses this spray, trying to target days when he has been practicing his sports or working out, sweating a lot. It is recommended that you do not use Hypochlorous Acid spray more than twice a day as overuse can disrupt the skins natural balance. It also does not take the place of a good cleanser and a healthy skincare routine. At the time of this review, this product is listed for under $10, which is a good value based on the size of the bottle. Based on what I have seen with my son’s skin so far, I would highly recommend!

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: The bottle I received looks different from the blue bottle on the product page which is the only reason I deducted a star. Having it look different makes me question what I received but it appears the size, brand, and ingredients are the same. This is a pump spray which is easy to use and gives a nice mist. I use this as a step in my face care. I normally spray it after washing as an extra cleanse but will also use it after the gym or anytime I'm really sweating and can't wash my face immediately. I love the smell of hypochlorous acid. It reminds me of a chlorinated pool but if that isn't your thing, the scent subsides after it dries, and it dries quickly.

avis.titre: It has many uses, but when I tried it on eczema on side of knee…the area turned it purple!
avis.texte: This is a review for Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Face and Skin, Piercing Aftercare Spray, 8 oz Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Face, Skin, Acne, Eczema, Body Acne Sprays, Piercing Aftercare, Facial Wound Solution, Workout (8 Fl Oz (Pack of 1)) I’m not sure what to think of this product. It’s supposed to have many uses including healing eczema, so I thought I’d try it. I had a spot of eczema on the side of my knee. I used the spray four days in a row, just one pump of the spray then rubbed it into the side of my knee each morning. The evening of the fourth day, I noticed that the spot was a deep purple! I wasn’t and still am uncertain what to think of that. It was rather startling. I stopped using the spray and left the area alone. Two weeks later, while most, but not all of the eczema appears to be gone, the area is still discolored. It is no longer a deep purple, but is a dark shade of pink. It never itched or hurt, only discolored. I truly don’t know how to feel about this. I’m very glad I didn’t try this on my face as I’d rather not have purple or deep pink spots on my face! Now, having said this, the only area that changed color is the exact area that had the eczema. It didn’t bother my hands or the area surrounding the eczema, even though the Hypochlorous Acid was rubbed into those areas as well. Based on that, I don’t believe I’m allergic to it. That’s why I’m confused! I have included a picture of the area on the side of my knee as it currently looks. Unfortunately, I didn
